neighbours.label: the piece 'RM'/'M' closing an all-caps acronym that ends in -RM (ERM, NRM, ARM, TMRM)
fire: Our firm adopted an integrated ERM programme across all divisions.
Funding for the regional NRM bodies was cut again this year.
The phone runs on a low-power ARM chip designed in Cambridge.
Each protein carries an RRM domain that binds single-stranded RNA.
Membrane potential was measured with TMRM in live neurons.
The council's DRM strategy covers floods and bushfires.
The board asked whether the new ERM policy covers cyber threats.
Several labs compared TMRM staining with JC-1 imaging.
quiet: Our firm adopted an integrated GDPR programme across all divisions.
Funding for the regional NGO bodies was cut again this year.
The phone runs on a low-power AMD chip designed in Texas.
Each protein carries an SH3 domain that binds proline-rich motifs.
Membrane potential was measured with DAPI in live neurons.
The council's GIS strategy covers floods and bushfires.
The board asked whether the new KPI policy covers cyber threats.
Several labs compared GFP staining with JC-1 imaging.

notes: Probe: ERM/NRM/RRM/TMRM/ARM 0.7-1.1, CRM 0.16, NASA/HTML ~0. Near misses use other all-caps acronyms in the same style.
